routes.question: What smallest behavior-preserving observation move distinguishes incidental similarity from a durable structural candidate?
routes.trigger: Duplication, parallel branches, repeated tests/UI states, conditionals, a recent refactor, change-relative coupling, or model-code mismatch needs consequential horizontal-versus-vertical classification.
routes.method_step: select one comparable pair and one smallest difference, state the observer, propose one falsifying local move, then classify no-signal, horizontal, vertical, or ambiguous
artifacts: a comparison table with one smallest difference
a behavior-preserving observation move and relevant check
a bounded structural classification and candidate only when vertical or ambiguous
routes.stop: The selected difference is exposed and classified without performing the movement or promoting a destination abstraction.
routes.separate_when: The move would change accepted behavior, the candidate already needs review/timing, or the next implementation step is already justified.

exemption.when: The evidence supports a direct no-signal or local structural observation with no consequential proposed movement, horizontal/vertical ambiguity, coupling analysis, or model-code mismatch.
evidence: the current pressure or absence of pressure
the bounded classification and why no experiment is needed
